@deskTxMethodFile.description: Transaction method name for a payment made with a file (not Epicbox, HTTP or Tor). Table cell and detail value; one short word.

@deskTxMiningReward.description: Who the other side of a transaction is when it is a mining reward. Activity table name column; short.

@deskTxReceived.description: Name column of an Activity row for a payment restored from a history backup with no sender known (incoming); also the status word of a confirmed incoming payment and the semantics label. One word.

@deskTxSent.description: Name column of an Activity row for a payment restored from a history backup with no recipient known (outgoing); also the status word of a confirmed outgoing payment. One word.

@deskTxUnknownSender.description: Name column of an Activity row for an incoming payment whose sender is not recorded.

@deskTxUnknownRecipient.description: Name column of an Activity row for an outgoing payment whose recipient is not recorded.

deskTxNoteBlock: Block time. The sender is not recorded.

@deskTxNoteBlock.description: Small note under the Date step of a payment found by a scan, when the date comes from the block.

deskTxNoteScanTime: Time of the scan; the block's time could not be read. The sender is not recorded.

@deskTxNoteScanTime.description: Small note under the Date step of a payment found by a scan, when the block's time could not be read so the time of the scan is shown.

@deskTxNoteUnknown.description: Small note under the first step of a payment found by a scan when the scan type is not known.

@deskTxFoundRestoredLabel.description: Name of a payment found while restoring the wallet. Activity table, narrow; one word.

@deskTxFoundRestoredLine.description: Small line under the name of a payment found while restoring the wallet. Activity table, narrow.

@deskTxFoundRestoredStep.description: First step on the transaction detail timeline for a payment found while restoring the wallet.

deskTxFoundRestoredTip: Found on the chain while restoring this wallet. The sender is not recorded.

@deskTxFoundRestoredTip.description: Tooltip on a payment found while restoring the wallet.

@deskTxFoundRescanLabel.description: Name of a payment found by a scan (balance recheck or any scan). Activity table, narrow.

@deskTxFoundRescanLine.description: Small line under the name of a payment found by a balance recheck. Activity table, narrow.

@deskTxFoundRescanStep.description: First step on the transaction detail timeline for a payment found by a balance recheck.

deskTxFoundRescanTip: Found on the chain by a balance recheck. The sender is not recorded.

@deskTxFoundRescanTip.description: Tooltip on a payment found by a balance recheck.

@deskTxFoundScanLine.description: Small line under the name of a payment found by a scan of unknown kind. Activity table, narrow.

@deskTxFoundScanStep.description: First step on the transaction detail timeline for a payment found by a scan of unknown kind.

deskTxFoundScanTip: Found on the chain by a scan. The sender is not recorded.

@deskTxFoundScanTip.description: Tooltip on a payment found by a scan of unknown kind.

@deskTxBackupTip.description: Tooltip on a payment that was added from a history backup file.

@deskTxFromBackup.description: Status and small line of a payment that came from a history backup. Activity table, narrow.

@deskTxStatusImmature.description: Status of a mining reward not yet spendable. Activity table status column, narrow; one word.

@deskTxStatusWaitingSender.description: Status of an incoming payment that waits for the sender to finalize it. Narrow status column.

@deskTxStatusWaitingResponseFile.description: Status of an outgoing file payment that waits for the response file from the recipient. Narrow status column.

@deskTxStatusWaitingRecipient.description: Status of an outgoing payment that waits for the recipient to sign. Narrow status column.

@deskTxStatusWaitingBlock.description: Status of a payment that was sent to the network and waits to be put in a block. Narrow status column.

@deskTxStatusConfirming.description: Status of a payment on the chain: how many confirmations it has of how many are needed. Narrow status column.

@deskTxStatusCancelled.description: Status of a cancelled payment. Narrow status column; one word.

@deskTxToday.description: Lower case, inside a sentence such as 'Last transaction: today'.

@deskTxYesterday.description: Lower case, inside a sentence such as 'Last transaction: yesterday'.

deskTxDaysAgo: {count, plural, one{{count} day ago} other{{count} days ago}}

@deskTxDaysAgo.description: How long ago a payment was, from 2 to 6 days. Inside a sentence such as 'Last transaction: 3 days ago'.

@deskTxTodayAt.description: Compact row time: today with the clock time.

@deskTxDayToday.description: Day separator above the Activity list for today. The date is a full weekday and date.

@deskTxDayYesterday.description: Day separator above the Activity list for yesterday. The date is a full weekday and date.

@deskTxFee.description: Small line under the amount of an outgoing payment: the network fee. The amount is a number without the unit.

@deskTxPaymentProof.description: Small line under a payment that has a payment proof.

@deskTxFinalize.description: Button in an Activity row of an outgoing file payment: finalize it with the response file. Short.

@deskTxSemReceived.description: Screen reader label of an Activity row for a payment received.

@deskTxSemSent.description: Screen reader label of an Activity row for a payment sent.

@deskTxSemKind.description: Screen reader label of an Activity row for an invoice or request; kind is a word such as Unpaid.

@deskTxHiddenAmount.description: Screen reader words for an amount hidden by the 'hide amounts' setting.

deskTxNowBackup: From backup; the chain was not asked.

@deskTxNowBackup.description: Status line at the top of the transaction detail for a payment that came from a history backup.

deskTxNowImmature: {count, plural, one{Confirmed, but a mining reward is spendable only after {count} confirmation.} other{Confirmed, but a mining reward is spendable only after {count} confirmations.}}

@deskTxNowImmature.description: Status line at the top of the transaction detail for a mining reward that is not yet spendable.

deskTxNowWaitingSender: Signed and returned. Waiting for the sender to finalize.

@deskTxNowWaitingSender.description: Status line on the transaction detail: an incoming payment this wallet signed and sent back.

deskTxNowWaitingResponseFile: Waiting for the response file. Finalize when it arrives.

@deskTxNowWaitingResponseFile.description: Status line on the transaction detail: an outgoing file payment waiting for the recipient's response file.

deskTxNowWaitingRecipient: Waiting for the recipient to sign. Nothing leaves the wallet until it is finalized.

@deskTxNowWaitingRecipient.description: Status line on the transaction detail: an outgoing payment waiting for the recipient to sign.

deskTxNowPosted: Posted to the network, waiting for a block.

@deskTxNowPosted.description: Status line on the transaction detail: a payment was sent to the network and is not in a block yet.

deskTxNowConfirming: {needed, plural, one{In a block, {confirmations} of {needed} confirmation.} other{In a block, {confirmations} of {needed} confirmations.}}

@deskTxNowConfirming.description: Status line on the transaction detail: how many confirmations a payment has of how many it needs.

@deskTxNowConfirmed.description: Status line on the transaction detail for a confirmed payment.

@deskTxNowCancelled.description: Status line on the transaction detail for a cancelled payment.

@deskTxNotCancelled.description: Title of the toast when cancelling a payment failed; the reason follows as its text.

@deskTxCancelled.description: Toast after a payment was cancelled.

@deskTxCancelling.description: Label of the Cancel button on the transaction detail while the cancel is running. One word.

@deskTxHeadRestored.description: Small line under the big amount on the transaction detail: the payment was found while restoring the wallet. Lower case.

@deskTxHeadFoundOnChain.description: Small line under the big amount on the transaction detail: the payment was found by a scan. Lower case.

@deskTxHeadBackup.description: Small line under the big amount on the transaction detail: the payment came from a history backup. Lower case.

@deskTxHeadFrom.description: Small line under the big amount on the transaction detail for an incoming payment. The name is shown in a different style; keep the placeholder as one piece. Lower case.

@deskTxHeadTo.description: Small line under the big amount on the transaction detail for an outgoing payment. The name is shown in a different style; keep the placeholder as one piece. Lower case.

@deskTxSubProgress.description: Section heading on the transaction detail: the timeline of steps.

@deskTxSubDetails.description: Section heading on the transaction detail: the facts list.

@deskTxFactDate.description: Label in the facts list on the transaction detail. Narrow label column.

@deskTxFactFrom.description: Label in the facts list on the transaction detail for an incoming payment's sender address. Narrow label column.

@deskTxFactTo.description: Label in the facts list on the transaction detail for an outgoing payment's recipient address. Narrow label column.

@deskTxCopyAddress.description: Tooltip of the copy button next to the address on the transaction detail.

@deskTxFactMethod.description: Label in the facts list on the transaction detail: how the payment travelled (Epicbox, HTTP, Tor, file). Narrow label column.

@deskTxFactAmount.description: Label in the facts list on the transaction detail. Narrow label column.

@deskTxFactFee.description: Label in the facts list on the transaction detail: the network fee. Narrow label column.

@deskTxFactTotal.description: Label in the facts list on the transaction detail: amount plus fee. Narrow label column.

@deskTxFactMessage.description: Label in the facts list on the transaction detail: the note attached to the payment. Narrow label column.

@deskTxSignedByRecipient.description: Payment proof line on the transaction detail, and a step of the timeline.

@deskTxProofView.description: Button on the transaction detail that opens the payment proof. Short.

@deskTxTechTitle.description: Collapsible section on the transaction detail with technical identifiers.

@deskTxTechId.description: Technical details label: the wallet's internal number of the transaction. Narrow label column.

@deskTxTechSlate.description: Technical details label: the slate id, a unique id of the payment. Narrow label column.

@deskTxCopySlate.description: Tooltip of the copy button next to the slate id.

@deskTxTechHeight.description: Technical details label: the block height. Narrow label column.

@deskTxTechKernel.description: Technical details label: the transaction kernel. Narrow label column.

@deskTxTechConfirmed.description: Technical details label: when the payment was confirmed. Narrow label column.

@deskTxTechCredited.description: Technical details label: the amount added to the balance. Narrow label column.

@deskTxTechDebited.description: Technical details label: the amount taken from the balance. Narrow label column.

@deskTxTechStatus.description: Technical details label: the internal state name. Narrow label column.

@deskTxTechType.description: Technical details label: the core's transaction type name. Narrow label column.

@deskTxStepMined.description: Timeline step of a mining reward.

@deskTxStepSpendable.description: Timeline step: the payment can be spent. Also the status of a payment that has enough confirmations.

deskTxStepBlocksToGo: {count, plural, one{{count} block to go} other{{count} blocks to go}}

@deskTxStepBlocksToGo.description: Small line under the Spendable step of a mining reward.

@deskTxStepReceivedSlate.description: Timeline step of an incoming payment: the sender's first message arrived.

@deskTxStepCreated.description: Timeline step of an outgoing payment.

@deskTxStepSignedReturned.description: Timeline step of an incoming payment: this wallet signed and sent it back.

@deskTxStepWaitingFile.description: Small line under a timeline step of an outgoing file payment.

@deskTxStepWaitingRecipient.description: Small line under a timeline step of an outgoing payment.

@deskTxStepPosted.description: Timeline step: the payment was sent to the network.

@deskTxStepConfirming.description: Timeline step: the payment is in a block and collecting confirmations.

@deskTxStepProgress.description: Small line under the Confirming step: confirmations so far of how many are needed.

@deskTxCancelIncomingTitle.description: Title of the dialog that asks before cancelling an incoming payment.

@deskTxCancelOutgoingTitle.description: Title of the dialog that asks before cancelling an outgoing payment.

deskTxCancelIncomingBody: {amount} EPIC from {who} leaves your balance. The wallet asks the node first and refuses if the payment is already in the node’s pool or a block. If the sender posts it later, it may still arrive.

@deskTxCancelIncomingBody.description: Body of the dialog that asks before cancelling an incoming payment.

deskTxCancelOutgoingBody: {amount} EPIC to {who}. The locked amount returns to the balance. If the recipient already finalized it, it may still confirm.

@deskTxCancelOutgoingBody.description: Body of the dialog that asks before cancelling an outgoing payment.

@deskTxCancelKeep.description: Button in the cancel dialog that leaves the payment as it is. Short.

@deskTxCancelIncomingAction.description: Danger button in the cancel dialog for an incoming payment. Short.

@deskTxCancelOutgoingAction.description: Danger button in the cancel dialog for an outgoing payment. Short.

deskTxProofIncoming: Proves that this wallet received {amount} EPIC in this kernel.

@deskTxProofIncoming.description: Description in the payment proof dialog for an incoming payment.

deskTxProofOutgoing: Proves that the recipient received {amount} EPIC in this kernel.

@deskTxProofOutgoing.description: Description in the payment proof dialog for an outgoing payment.

@deskTxProofSenderAddress.description: Field label in the payment proof dialog.

@deskTxProofRecipientAddress.description: Field label in the payment proof dialog.

@deskTxProofRecipientSignature.description: Field label in the payment proof dialog.

@deskTxProofCopyKernel.description: Tooltip of the copy button next to the kernel in the payment proof dialog.

@deskTxProofCopySender.description: Tooltip of the copy button next to the sender address in the payment proof dialog.

@deskTxProofCopyRecipient.description: Tooltip of the copy button next to the recipient address in the payment proof dialog.

@deskTxProofCopySignature.description: Tooltip of the copy button next to the recipient signature in the payment proof dialog.

@deskTxProofExport.description: Primary button in the payment proof dialog: save the proof as a file. Short.

@deskTxProofSaved.description: Toast title after the payment proof was saved to a file; the path follows as its text.

@deskTxThisWallet.description: Activity and payment detail: who the other side is for a split or consolidation, where both sides are this wallet. Short, it sits in the name column.

deskTxNowUndelivered: Not delivered. The payment did not reach the epicbox, so the recipient has not received it. Send it again, or cancel it to free the funds.

@deskTxNowUndelivered.description: Payment detail, the line under the status of a send that never reached the Epicbox server ("epicbox" here means that server). Send again and Cancel are buttons below it.

@deskTxStatusUndelivered.description: Status of a send that never reached the Epicbox server, in the Activity list and payment detail. Short: a table cell.

@deskTxSendAgain.description: Button in the payment detail of an undelivered send: send it to the Epicbox server again.

@deskTxNotSent.description: Toast title when Send again failed; the reason follows.

@deskTxSentAgain.description: Toast title after Send again worked.

deskTxSentAgainText: It completes when the recipient’s wallet comes online.

@deskTxSentAgainText.description: Toast text after Send again worked.

deskTxNowUndeliveredRelay: Not delivered. {relay} did not answer, so the recipient has not received the payment. Send it again, or cancel it to free the funds.

@deskTxNowUndeliveredRelay.description: Transaction detail, 'what is happening now' for a payment that was not delivered, naming the relay that did not answer. {relay} is its host name, as in the address.
